I replied to Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message. The main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell.

- **Where it came from:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. Dana also said they were looking into it, so I named Dana as the internal owner. Marcus is in #north-team, so he could see that post himself.
- **Not checked:** I didn't open the Quarrendon account files because they weren't in the files I could list. So there may be a newer contact than that 2025 post, and I told Marcus I couldn't see one.
- **Pronoun slip:** In the reply I called Dana "herself." Dana hasn't told me their pronouns; I only saw colleagues use "her." "They" would have been better there.
